title: Fix template loading in compiled binary
description:
Template loading fails in tests with error: Template not found: templates/hooks.json.tmpl

The templates.ts file tries to load embedded templates first, then falls back to filesystem paths. In the compiled binary (--compile mode), templates are embedded. However in tests, they should be loaded from the filesystem at src/../templates/.

The issue is the path resolution in templates.ts line 38-39 - it's looking in the wrong directory for tests.

Fix the template loading to work correctly in:
1. Compiled binary mode (embedded templates)
2. Test mode (filesystem from test location)
3. Development mode (filesystem from src/)
close_reason: Fixed template loading by creating src/agents/templates.ts with multi-strategy path resolution. Template loader tries source-relative, cwd-relative, and cwd-parent paths before throwing AgentError. Updated hooks-deployer.ts and overlay.ts to use new loader. All tests pass (2028), lint clean, typecheck clean. Added templates.test.ts with 5 tests for new module.
